items.text: After airing a program about the name of the Caspian Sea, IRIB displayed the name "Caspian" instead of "Khazar" on weather maps. It is unclear whether this change follows an official directive. This action followed Ahmad Kazemi's remarks about the historical names of the sea.

Barcelona defeated Galatasaray 4-1 in the second week of the Champions League. Galatasaray led in the first half, but Barcelona scored four goals in the second half. The goals for Barcelona were scored by Cancelo, Lopez, Gordon, and Ademi.

In the second week of the Asian Elite League, Shabab Al Ahli UAE defeated Al-Ittihad Saudi Arabia 2-1 with Sardar Azmoun's outstanding performance. Azmoun scored both goals for his team, and Reza Ghandipour assisted the second goal. Shabab Al Ahli reached 6 points and ranked fourth with this victory.

The US Central Command rejected the claim by the IRGC Navy commander about controlling the Strait of Hormuz. CENTCOM stated that US forces and regional partners clearly control the strait. It also mentioned that the US helped Gulf countries in transporting crude oil through the strait.

A group of political prisoners in various prisons of the Islamic Republic sent a message on the birthday of Empress Farah Pahlavi, calling her a symbol of Iranian culture and art. They expressed hope that one day her birthday celebration will be held in a free and prosperous Iran.

Saudi Arabia conducted airstrikes targeting oil facilities in areas controlled by the Houthis in Yemen. The attacks hit a fuel station in Sana'a, storage tanks at Ras Issa port, and another location in Bajil district. These areas are located in the Hodeidah province.

A ballistic missile struck the administrative tower of the Aramco complex in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia. The top three floors of the tower were damaged and a fire broke out. Aramco has not yet issued an official response to the incident.

Jamshid Barzegar stated that sanctions alone have not prevented the Islamic Republic's overseas operations. He added that targeted sanctions against officials and affiliates can limit the operational and security capabilities of the Islamic Republic. These remarks were made regarding the expansion of the IRGC's overseas activities.

Murad Vaisi announced a successful test of direct mobile phone connection to satellites in Italy. This technology may cause a significant leap in communications in the coming months. Its expansion could limit the Iranian regime's ability to completely cut off the internet during protests.

Gina Romero, the UN special rapporteur, thanked global solidarity with her 24-hour hunger strike supporting the "No to Execution Tuesdays" campaign. She said this solidarity deeply affected her. Romero hopes for a day when the death penalty is completely abolished.

Morad Vaisi, a senior analyst at Iran International, referred to a Wall Street Journal report stating that the Islamic Republic is preparing for war. A ground conflict scenario and the possibility of attacks on countries like Kuwait and Saudi Arabia are part of Tehran's military calculations. Iranian military officials have previously discussed such scenarios.

Egypt has announced its readiness to provide any assistance to Saudi Arabia. Analysts doubt whether Egypt's direct involvement can stop the Houthi attacks. The US remains uncertain about entering the conflict but supports the Saudi-led coalition.

The head of the Health and Treatment Commission of the Parliament warned about shortages of medical equipment and consumables in some public hospitals. Patients are required to bring their own sheets, blankets, and clothes when admitted. Additionally, rising drug prices and insufficient funding for special disease funds have raised concerns.

The judiciary of the Islamic Republic executed the death sentence of political prisoner Ali-Sina Mostafavi. He was accused of two shootings in Kerman and was also present in the protests of December 2025. Reports indicate that forced confessions were obtained from Mostafavi.

Tasnim news agency reported that a drone attack on a fishing boat near Sirik injured three people. Tasnim stated that the attack was carried out by the United States. The exact details of the incident have not yet been officially announced.

The exhibition "Dreams in Rupture" featuring works by Afshin Naghoni was held in London. Live music was performed by Amir Konjani. This project combines painting and music to offer a fresh perspective on history and art.
Alisina Mostafavi, a prisoner accused of waging war, was executed in Kerman. The sentence was carried out after confirmation by the Supreme Court. The execution took place on Wednesday, October 14.

The Vatican announced that the surgery of Pope Leo XIV was successful. Examination of lung tissues confirmed his lung cancer diagnosis. The Pope regained consciousness after the operation and returned to his room.

Donald Trump mentioned the possibility of asking Recep Tayyip Erdogan for support for Saudi Arabia. Erdogan emphasized Ankara's support for Riyadh. The Turkish defense minister also spoke of joint steps to implement the Mecca pact.

RJ Mitte, an American actor known for his role in the series "Breaking Bad," passed away at the age of 34. He lived with cerebral palsy and used his fame to raise awareness about disability. Mitte supported the inclusion of people with disabilities in the entertainment industry.

The Wall Street Journal reported that the Houthis are trying to build a version of the Khaibar Shekan ballistic missile using imported parts from China. This comes amid ongoing tensions between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia. More details were reported by Alireza Mohibi.

Mohammad Javad Akbarin from Iran International stated that the Yemeni army and the Arab coalition have the upper hand in areas controlled by the Houthis. Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia have intensified. The Houthis have also been able to import missile equipment from China and assemble it inside Yemen.

Ahmad Alavi, an economist, warned about rising living costs and insufficient wages for workers. He said that continuing this situation could transfer poverty to the next generation and have social consequences. He also mentioned the possibility of public uprisings if economic, social, and political problems persist.

The China Global South Project think tank reported an increase in the influence of the IRGC in Iran's oil trade and a decrease in the role of the National Iranian Oil Company. Networks affiliated with the IRGC generate revenue by circumventing sanctions, and independent Chinese refineries have become the main buyers of Iranian oil. These buyers may turn to other countries if they find cheaper oil.

The Pallet music group canceled their concert tour in Iran due to opposition in some cities to the presence of a female musician. The group stated they will only perform when all members can be on stage. The members protested the restrictions faced by female musicians.

Mohsen Rafiqdoost stated that if American forces enter Iranian territory, they will either be captured or killed. He did not rule out the possibility of a ground war and said the Islamic Republic has the strongest ground forces in the world. He also mentioned that if a crisis arises, Iran will launch a preemptive attack.

FIFA signed a lease contract in spring 2025 to rent an office in Trump Tower for seven years and seven months, worth nearly 4 million dollars. The contract was made with a company related to Donald Trump's family, raising concerns about conflicts of interest. FIFA stated that the rent price complies with market rates.

A video on social media shows Alireza Sepahi's sister mourning at his grave in Kashan at night. Alireza Sepahi was the accused in the Ali Khani Square case in Isfahan. He was executed early morning on Tuesday, October 5, at Dastgerd prison in Isfahan.

The human rights group Hal-Wash released a video on Tuesday, October 13, showing the flight path of a missile in the sky over Dashtiari, Chabahar. Local witnesses confirmed the missile was fired from military positions around Chabahar. The video was published alongside reports of extensive movement of weapons, drones, and missiles by the Islamic Republic and escalating clashes in Sistan and Baluchestan province.

Mehdi Tartaar said after the match with Kheybar Khorramabad that sometimes the ball does not enter the goal and better performance can be achieved with more practice. He pointed to missed opportunities and emphasized the need to work on this issue. He also stated that tactical variety is needed to earn three points and that Kheybar is a respectable team.

Mehdi Ebadollahi, 36 years old, was killed in Tehran on January 9, 2026. His mother expressed her longing by placing nine apples symbolizing nine months of pregnancy and separation from her son. She asked, "Where are you, my brave boy?"

The IRGC Navy announced that the container ship "GFS Pride" struck a mine and sank on the morning of Wednesday, October 14, in the southern waters of the Strait of Hormuz. The ship carried over 2,500 containers and attempted to pass through an unauthorized route. Additionally, the bulk carrier "Cape Dao" is sinking, and attacks on several other ships have been reported.

Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu said a military action against Iran before the elections is not suitable for Israel. He promised that if re-elected, Hamas and Hezbollah would be destroyed and the Iranian government overthrown. Times of Israel noted past efforts by the US and Israel to downplay the possibility of an attack on Iran.

A group of unemployed youth from Shahr-e Har gathered in front of the Sugarcane Development and Related Industries Company in Ahvaz. They demanded attention to their employment demands and the provision of job opportunities at Haft Tappeh Sugarcane Agro-Industry Company.
An audio version of Cheshmandaz has been released about the countdown to a renewed attack by the US and Israel.

Asiyeh Ramazani's daughter said in a video that her mother was killed on January 9, 2026, in Tehran during a protest. The killer did not dare to look into her eyes and shot her from behind. These statements were shared on social media.

People report economic and social problems such as unemployment, high housing costs, rising medical expenses, and shortages of essential goods. There are also mentions of political repression and restrictions caused by military exercises. The report includes various accounts from different cities in Iran.

Netanyahu stated that Israel will eventually overthrow the Islamic Republic. These remarks were made in the audio version of program 24 with Fardad Farahzad. The topic concerns Israel's policies towards the Islamic Republic.

CENTCOM announced that US forces destroyed a boat linked to the Islamic Republic on October 6 in the Sea of Oman. The crew safely exited the boat before its destruction, and efforts to return them continue. The IRGC has targeted thousands of civilian mariners in the region over the past seven months.

Pep Guardiola went to the Etihad Stadium on Wednesday to watch Manchester City's match against Paris Saint-Germain in the Champions League. It was City's first home game since the club was found guilty of breaching financial regulations. Guardiola sat in the directors' box alongside Khaldoon Al Mubarak and Nasser Al-Khelaifi.

A video shows that the Toos power plant in Mashhad caused pollution by burning mazut on Wednesday, October 14. The video was received by Iran International. The issue of pollution caused by mazut burning at this power plant has been raised.
